'''Mercenaries''' is the third of three releases of [[Virtual Block 6]], a legacy virtual expansion. Its text is official as of 15 March 2010.<ref name="pdf" /> The release has 34 cards: 21 Dark Side and 13 Light Side.

== Discrepancies ==
* Printed as Bane, The Bounty Hunter; later released as [[Cad Bane (Dark)]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="dl">[https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183346/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* Printed as The Emperor's Reach; later released as [[Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach (Dark)]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="dl" />
* The alternate-image version [[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 6)]] on the [[Virtual Block 6]] card list is not in this release PDF.<ref name="pdf" />
